The '''Technology Advocate''' was an advocate seat on the [[Players Committee]]'s Advocate Council. On the chart of May 2024 the Technology team is under the [[Rules Advocate]].<ref name="oc2024">PC organization chart PDF (PDF creation date 6 May 2024), [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (Wayback copy of 10 October 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf archived PDF])</ref>

== Holders ==

Each range runs from the month the holder is first documented to the month the holder is no longer listed, as on [[Players Committee advocates]]. Each holder appears once, on the row that gives their whole tenure.
